motion.value: backdrop 1050ms/0ms; title 800ms/60ms; copy 650ms/120ms; foreground 950ms/120ms; choice-1 600ms/180ms; choice-2 600ms/240ms
motion.name: intro
motion.purpose: First landing only; duration/delay. Choice wrappers use backwards fill.

motion.name: stage-enter
motion.purpose: New stage starts at opacity zero, 14px below.

motion.name: fallback
motion.purpose: Main-element entry without native view transitions.

extensions.reducedMotion: Scene intro and native transitions off; depth reset; animated navigation bypassed. Transform transitions off; cinematic control background/color changes retain 120ms ease.

themePreference.scope: Welcome only; other route preferences remain unchanged.

extensions.scope: docs/welcome/DESIGN.md only. Public root Welcome; leadership and Dashboard excluded.

pointerDepth.gate: Fine hover pointer, no reduced motion, visible intersecting landing, visible document, focused window, non-touch input
pointerDepth.stop: Settled, hidden, blur, keydown, view exit, intersection loss, reduced-motion or pointer-capability change

navigation.direct: Same-view anchors, keyboard, reduced motion, history/hash restoration

assets.classification: AI fantasy illustration, not a Kingshot screenshot

components.name: Cinematic Member Choice
components.css: .scene-choice{display:block;padding:19px 22px;border-radius:7px;background:#dfbd79;color:#292419;border:1px solid #e9ce99;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #0003;transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),background-color 180ms ease}.scene-choice strong{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:650}.scene-choice span{font-size:12px}.scene-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f5d58e;outline-offset:5px}.scene-choice:active{transform:scale(.985)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.scene-choice:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:#ebcd91}.scene-choice:hover:active{transform:scale(.985)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.scene-choice{transition:background-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease}}

rules.body: Current markup and final cinematic overrides govern Welcome.
rules.name: The Cascade Rule

narrative.overview: Midnight citadel illustration, warm gold, self-hosted Cinzel, Inter, and official crownless Helga create an authored Kingshot scene. Member and transfer retain progressive disclosure.
dos: Keep keyboard and reduced navigation direct and choices usable during entry.
Preserve singleton schedule, cached contacts, central Discord, and deployment boundaries.
donts: Do not call the AI illustration a game screenshot.
Do not add infinite loops or move text with pointer depth.
Do not bind CTA entry and hover to the same transform owner.
Do not alter Dashboard or leadership identity.
